questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct subject–verb agreement: Neither the main report nor its appendices ___ been checked, although the index ___ ready.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct subject–verb agreement: Either the lecturers or the principal ___ required to sign, and the attendance sheets ___ ready.
